eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Plumas, CA; at 9:03 AM on AUG 27, 2020 Effective until 11:03 AM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: This is an Evacuation Advisory Alert for Bucks Lake south of Bucks Lake Lodge to include Big Creek Road from Bucklin Road to China Gulch and south of Big Creek Road to Mount Ararat  Please make preparations to evacuate If you have special needs you should evacuate now If you have large animals make arrangements to move them immediately Additional alerts may be sent with updated information
